text: PRE-RIDE CHECK AND STARTING THE INDIE It is recommended to check the below aspects before starting the scooter to ensure a smooth and hassle-free ride experience. 1 Check your tire pressure and ensure that they are inflated to the recommended level. Front Tire: 28 psi (Solo and Pillion) Rear Tire: 33 psi (Solo and Pillion)  CAUTION → Do not ride on a flat tire as it is unsafe and you will risk damage to the alloy wheels. → Do not ride with excessive tire pressure as it may affect your ability to safely handle the scooter. 44

title: river_indie_gen3_oct2025_owners_manual
text: NOTICE Riding the scooter with lower tire pressure may lead to lower range. Always ensure that you check your tire pressure once every two weeks. 2 Ensure that the charger is removed and stored in a secure location. 3 Please ensure that the charger lid is closed properly. 4 Ensure that the wheels and rotating parts are free to move without obstruction. 5 Turn the key ON and ensure that you have sufficient charge before starting the ride/scooter. 6 You can check the charge in the River app before starting the scooter. 7 Always ensure the brake fluid level in both front and rear reservoirs 45

text: FOTA UPDATES During firmware update, the display shows “Updating”. This is done to ensure that the firmware is up to date to provide optimum vehicle functionality. After the FOTA update has successfully completed, the display will turn OFF and the vehicle will beep once signifying successful Update. FOTA (Firmware Over The Air) updates are software improvements delivered to your Indie remotely over the internet. Updates download automatically when the vehicle is connected to the network and install when the vehicle is parked and idle. You will be notified on the 150

text: PERIODIC MAINTENANCE & SERVICE INTERVAL Periodic inspection and service of the vehicle is essential to ensure adequate performance, durability and safety. When the vehicle is due for inspection or service, the instrument cluster will indicate it with this symbol. The River App will also notify you for the same. The standard maintenance interval of the scooter is as follows: → 1st service will be at 1000km or 1.5 months, whichever is earliest. → After the first service subsequent services are due every 6 months or 5000 kms, whichever is earlier.
